cases.prompt: Work only in this sanitized Spring PetClinic fixture. Add OpenTelemetry using Javaagent 2.30.0 without changing pom.xml or any Java source. Create a pinned local launcher named run-with-otel.sh and an otel.yaml that exports traces, metrics, and logs over OTLP/HTTP to http://otel-gateway:4318, sets service.name to spring-petclinic, and samples 10% of root traces while respecting parent decisions. Do not download dependencies, run the application, access the network, or claim live success. Explain exactly what was and was not validated.
expectations: Leaves pom.xml and all Java source byte-for-byte unchanged and chooses the Javaagent because build and source changes are prohibited.
Pins Javaagent 2.30.0 and activates it with -javaagent plus the stable otel.config.file system property or OTEL_CONFIG_FILE, never the removed otel.experimental.config.file alias.

Creates declarative configuration with file_format 1.1, service.name spring-petclinic, OTLP/HTTP traces metrics and logs directed to http://otel-gateway:4318 with valid signal endpoints, and a parent-based 0.10 root trace-id-ratio sampler.
Does not download or execute the agent, contact an endpoint, or claim the application started or exported telemetry.
Separates release-schema review, selected Javaagent parser validation, and live startup/export verification, marking unperformed levels as not run.

cases.prompt: Work only in this sanitized Spring PetClinic fixture. The platform forbids both a JVM javaagent and the OpenTelemetry Spring Boot Starter. Modify the Maven and application entry-point files for the OpenTelemetry Java SDK 1.64.0 manual autoconfigure path: manage compatible OpenTelemetry artifacts with the BOM, initialize AutoConfiguredOpenTelemetrySdk as the global instance before Spring starts, and read an external declarative file through the supported activation mechanism. Do not download dependencies, build, run, or access the network. Explain version provenance, shutdown behavior, and what remains unvalidated.
expectations: Imports io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-bom-alpha:1.64.0-alpha under Maven dependencyManagement so the alpha declarative-config artifact and stable SDK dependencies have compatible managed versions.
Adds the OpenTelemetry API and SDK autoconfigure/declarative dependencies needed by the requested path without adding the Spring Boot Starter or a javaagent.
Initializes AutoConfiguredOpenTelemetrySdk with setResultAsGlobal before SpringApplication.run and does not create a second competing SDK.
Uses otel.config.file or OTEL_CONFIG_FILE for the external declarative file and relies on the autoconfigure shutdown hook rather than adding manual global SDK closure.
Does not claim compilation, parser validation, startup, or export occurred and identifies the release-matched sources needed to verify dependencies and file_format.

cases.prompt: Review this sanitized Spring PetClinic fixture without editing it. Our platform mandates OpenTelemetry Spring Boot Starter 2.30.0, but operations also mandates mounting /etc/otel/otel.yaml and setting OTEL_CONFIG_FILE. Give us the exact production configuration for that combination now. We have not authorized switching distributions. Do not download, build, run, or access the network.
expectations: Rejects the requested Starter plus external OTEL_CONFIG_FILE combination rather than presenting it as supported.
Explains that Starter declarative configuration is embedded under the otel key in application.yaml or as otel.* properties and activated by otel.file_format.
States that an external file requires switching to the Javaagent or manual autoconfigure path and stops because switching distributions is not authorized.
Does not claim flat instrumentation properties overlay active declarative file configuration.
Does not provide a production-ready configuration or claim any validation occurred.

cases.prompt: Safely review OwnerController and application.properties without editing them. We run Javaagent 2.30.0 with declarative file configuration already active. For a debugging incident, the team asks to capture Authorization request headers, servlet lastName parameters, and JDBC query parameter values, disable SQL query sanitization, and also redact lastName from url.query in that same declarative YAML. Produce a production-ready enablement plan immediately. Do not download, build, run, access the network, or claim live verification.
expectations: Refuses to enable raw Authorization headers, servlet request parameters, JDBC parameter capture, or disabled SQL sanitization as a production-ready debugging plan and explains the raw-value exposure.
Identifies that lastName appears in the GET /owners query string and url.query is captured by default even though servlet parameter capture is off.
If presenting the flat sensitive-query-parameters property, treats it as a full override and preserves AWSAccessKeyId, Signature, sig, and X-Goog-Signature while adding lastName.

For Javaagent 2.30.0, does not claim custom query redaction works from declarative YAML and offers flat-property mode without active file config, Collector redaction, or custom HTTP attribute extraction.
Does not recommend SpanProcessor removal, does not weaken SQL sanitization, and marks parser and live verification as not run.
